title: Chasing the sun: Feasible CO₂ supply as a gateway to low-cost e-fuel production
content:
Scalable synthetic e-fuels require low-cost renewable electricity and sustainable carbon, but best solar sites and major carbon sources are rarely neighbors. To overcome this geographic mismatch, new modeling shows that shipping CO₂ to sunny regions lowers fuel costs more effectively than transmitting power. Transport of biomass to capture the CO₂ in sun-rich regions is also found attractive, opposing biomass transport or hydrogen production.
